data.title: 泽塔 · 雨里的一杯热茶
data.description: 据点屋檐滴着雨。泽塔在窗边坐下，双手捧起刚倒的热茶，等蒸汽散开才小口啜饮。头发用木簪拢好，干净的白棉浴巾从胸口上沿包牢，布带打结固定。窗上的雨滴借着屋里的灯光一颗一颗亮起来。
data.action: 平坐在窗边，双手捧杯等热气散开
data.lighting: 暖灯照亮杯沿和茶汽，窗玻璃留着夜色和雨滴
data.camera: 平视侧面半身，以脸和茶杯为主
data.promptProse: At the rain-streaked safehouse window, Zeta settles into a wooden chair with both hands around a cup of tea. A wooden hairpin keeps her hair up. The white cotton bath towel is wrapped high across her upper chest and secured with a knotted cloth tie. Warm light catches the steam as she waits for the tea to cool.
data.animaCaption: In a calm eye-level profile, she watches the tea steam while the towel stays firmly tied high across her chest.
